description: Inbound policy — reverse-engineered from Claude Code crossSessionInbound / isolatePeerMachines. Controls how this machine's sessions handle incoming peer messages.

policies.accept: deliver immediately between tool calls, or start new turn if idle
policies.hold: hold for approval (approval dialog, 5min expiry, max 100 held, oldest dropped)
policies.refuse: drop inbound without delivery, still binds inbox file

note: Same-machine file inbox never traverses Anthropic servers; cross-machine via git push would traverse git remote. File inbox is per-session JSONL at sessions/inbox/<session>.jsonl, bound similarly to CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET.
